bibl.title: The New Politics of Olympos. Kingship in Kallimachos' Hymns.
bibl.seg: Michael Brumbaugh, The New Politics of Olympos. Kingship in Kallimachos' Hymns.
Oxford - New York, Oxford University Press, 2019, xviii-298 pp. ISBN 978-0-19-005926-2. £55.
C.R. par Kathleen Kidder, BMCRev < https://bmcr.brynmawr.edu/2021/2021.02.10/ >. - Jacqueline Klooster, Klio 103 (2021) pp. 726-729. - Michele Solitario, Lexis 39 (2021) pp. 247-252.

The Poetics of Praise in the Hymn to Zeus. - Part II: The divine family and the Ptolemaic dynasty: 4. Apollo as a New Paradigm for Kingship; - 5. Saviors, Tyrants, and the Poetics of Empire; - 6. On the Good Queen. - Conclusion: On the good king according to Kallimachos. - Bibliography.
